properties.headline: High Surf Advisory issued July 22 at 4:05PM HST until July 24 at 6:00AM HST by NWS Honolulu HI
properties.description:
...HIGH SURF ADVISORY FOR SOUTH FACING SHORES THROUGH THURSDAY
NIGHT...

.Forerunners from a moderate, long-period south swell are already
reaching Hawaii this afternoon. The swell builds tonight into
Thursday, with surf increasing to advisory level along south-
facing shores sometime on Thursday. Thursday night into Friday,
the swell may peak near warning level. Long-period south swell
energy will keep surf elevated beyond Friday, which may require
the advisory to be extended through the weekend.

* WHAT...Surf 8 to 12 ft.

* WHERE...South facing shores of all Hawaiian Islands.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Thursday to 6 AM HST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Moderate. Strong breaking waves and strong currents
will make swimming dangerous.
properties.instruction:
Heed all advice from ocean safety officials. When in doubt, don't
go out.

NWSheadline: HIGH SURF ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 6 AM THURSDAY TO 6 AM HST FRIDAY
